name: KaraokeDock
description: A modern, full-featured web-based karaoke system with support for multiple media formats, real-time queue management, and external karaoke integration. Requires a PostgreSQL database. See the Unraid README: https://github.com/haggardj2/KaraokeDock/blob/main/docs/Unraid_readme.md

paths.name: Karaoke Tracks
paths.description: Path to your karaoke tracks. Mounted read-only.

paths.name: Break Music
paths.description: Path to break music. Mounted read-only.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the KaraokeDock web interface.

variables.name: Database Port
variables.description: PostgreSQL port. Use 5432 for the shared Postgres container.

variables.name: Web App URL
variables.description: Public URL for the app, such as http://192.168.100.63:5173 or https://karaoke.example.com.

variables.name: Allowed Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated CORS/WebSocket origins. Include your LAN URL and reverse proxy URL if used.

variables.name: Host Key 8
variables.description: Use this rule of thumb: **4-core CPU:** 8 to 12, **6-core CPU:** 12 to 16, **8+ cores:** 16 to 24. If your server is otherwise idle and the media lives on fast storage, 20` or 24` is reasonable. If you notice high CPU, disk thrash, or sluggishness during scans, back it down. If you **don’t set it at all**, the app now auto-picks a value based on CPU count, capped between **10** and **24**.

variables.name: Media Root
variables.description: Root media path inside the container.

variables.name: Trust Proxy
variables.description: Set to 1 when running behind a reverse proxy.
